raw_text:
Karthik Suresh 
Mechanical Engineer — Production 
Palakkad, Kerala   |   karthik.suresh@example.com   |   89430XXXXX 
PROFILE 
 
Mechanical engineer with 8 years of experience in production planning and process improvement within 
automotive component manufacturing. Skilled at applying Six Sigma methods to reduce scrap and improve line 
efficiency, with hands-on experience across design, quality, and production functions. 
AREAS OF EXPERTISE 
 
AutoCAD   –   SolidWorks   –   GD&T   –   Production planning (MRP)   –   Six Sigma (Green Belt)   –   Root 
cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone)   –   Shop-floor team supervision   –   Cross-functional coordination   –   
Process documentation 
CAREER HISTORY 
 
Senior Engineer — Production — Anantha Auto Components, Palakkad 
Jun 2022 – Present 
– Lead production planning for a line producing 15,000 units per month 
– Reduced scrap rate by 12% through a Six Sigma improvement project 
– Supervise a shop-floor team of 10 technicians across 2 shifts 
– Redesigned 3 tooling fixtures, cutting cycle time by 8% 
Engineer — Production — Anantha Auto Components, Palakkad 
Jul 2019 – May 2022 
– Rotated across design, quality, and production functions during the trainee program 
– Investigated and closed 40+ non-conformance reports with root-cause corrective actions 
– Coordinated with suppliers to resolve 3 recurring component-quality issues 
Graduate Engineer Trainee — Anantha Auto Components, Palakkad 
Jul 2016 – Jun 2019 
– Supported line engineers on daily production troubleshooting 
– Assisted in the rollout of a new inventory tracking system 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 
 
– Six Sigma project saved the plant an estimated ₹8 lakh annually in scrap and rework costs 
– Recognized with the plant's 'Continuous Improvement Award' in 2023 
 

ACADEMIC BACKGROUND 
 
B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering — College of Engineering Trivandrum (2012 – 2016), 7.8 CGPA 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
 
Certifications: Six Sigma Green Belt (2021); SolidWorks Associate Certification (2018) 
Languages: English (fluent), Malayalam (native), Tamil (conversational) 
Additional Information: Internal trainer for new shop-floor hires on GD&T fundamentals
